x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/checklist/list_templates/%7Blist_template_id%7D/sections", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"section\":{\"name\":\"Fall Protection and Perimeter Protection\",\"position\":1}}"

headers = {
    'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN",
    'content-type': "application/json"
    }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/checklist/list_templates/%7Blist_template_id%7D/sections", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
